title: Cottage 62 Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutCottage 62 ~ 62 Canal Street ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 3-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 3-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Cottage 62 is a completely renovated, charming 1,144sf bungalow located in Old Seagrove, with 3 bedrooms/2 baths, sleeping up to 6. Neighborhood beach access within a 5-minute stroll; Seaside just a 10-minute bike ride away; Publix and WaterColor Crossing just a 5-minute ride. Perfect for small families - everyone LOVES Cottage 62!! On-street parking is not allowed; please see parking spaces below and plan accordingly. Owned by the same family since it was built, Cottage 62 is lovingly maintained, incredibly well-stocked, tastefully and thoughtfully appointed, and just an absolute dream! Oh, and don't forget to get some Deep Fried Love at the renowned Seagrove Village Market, just 2 blocks away! Main level: Open,vaulted living area. Dining table seats 6, with stools for 4 along quartz counter. Fully equipped kitchen. #1 Bedroom has a King bed #2 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full bath with tub/shower is shared by #1 and #2 Bedrooms #3 Bedroom (Master) has a King bed Master bath with walk-in shower Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 Smart TVs (no cable/local channels, streaming available with guest login credentials) Board games Distinctive Features Walk/bike to Seaside 5-minute walk to beach Luxurious Tuft & Needle mattresses Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 3 vehicles 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed 2 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 2 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor deck, deck furniture Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, 2 coffee makers (1 Keurig), gas range, refrigerator with icemaker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, toaster oven, washer,dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (3/4 mile) WaterColor (1½ mile) Grayton Beach (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
